newsitem.title: USA: Mason-Dixon shareholders nix plan to pursue sale.
newsitem.headline: Mason-Dixon shareholders nix plan to pursue sale.

text.p: Mason-Dixon Bancshares said Monday that shareholders, at its annual meeting on April 19, voted overwhelmingly to defeat a stockholder proposal from a dissident group that would require it to pursue a sale of the company.
The company said that of the 4,278,646 shares cast only 643,723 were voted in favor of the proposal.

The company said that it was gratified that the stockholders have expressed confidence and support for management, and that it remains fully committed to maximizing stockholder values while fulfilling its commitment to customers, employees and its community.
